name: viridis-ghg-ledger
description: Auditable Scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse-gas inventories from activity data, with factor lineage and a verifiable audit hash.

interface.longDescription: GHG Ledger turns explicit activity records (fuel, electricity, refrigerants, waste, business travel and starter Scope 3 spend) into a deterministic greenhouse-gas inventory: per-line CO2e, Scope 1/2/3 and category rollups, location- and market-based Scope 2, the exact emission factors and sources used (EPA, eGRID, UK DESNZ, IPCC AR6 GWP-100), and an audit hash anyone can recompute with verify_result. There is no inference and no guessed factor: anything outside the bundled factor pack is returned as indeterminate rather than estimated. Calculations are stateless; it calculates the data you supply and is not accounting or assurance advice.
capabilities: Calculate Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions from activity data
Show the exact emission factors and sources used
Verify a prior inventory's audit hash
Classify activities into scopes and Scope 3 categories
defaultPrompt: Calculate Scope 2 emissions for 1,000 kWh of US grid electricity in 2023.
Which emission factors and sources does GHG Ledger use for US electricity in 2023?
Which scope is purchased electricity, and which Scope 3 categories exist?

positive.prompt: Use Viridis GHG Ledger to calculate the inventory for 1000 kWh purchased_electricity, region US, year 2023.
positive.expected_behavior: status ok, inventory_status complete_for_supplied_activities, 349.742 kg CO2e Scope 2 location-based using factor epa_egrid2023_us_total_ar6 with its EPA source, market-based Scope 2 marked indeterminate (no supplier factor supplied), and an audit_sha256.

positive.prompt: Verify that GHG inventory result with verify_result.
positive.expected_behavior: valid is true and audit_hash_valid is true for the untouched result; changing any total makes valid false.

positive.prompt: Which regions, years and activity types does the GHG Ledger factor pack cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pack version 2026.07.13-v0.1.0 with its SHA-256, regions GLOBAL, UK, US, US-CAMX, US-ERCT, years 2021, 2023, 2025 and 2026, and 11 activity types, plus the AR6 GWP-100 set.

positive.description: Exact factors and sources for one region/year
positive.prompt: Show the emission factors and sources for US 2023.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the eGRID 2023 US total factor (771.05 lb CO2e/MWh), unit conversions, GWP values and the EPA and IPCC source citations; no nearest-year substitution.

positive.prompt: Which scope does purchased electricity fall under?
positive.expected_behavior: supported true, suggestion scope_2 / purchased_electricity from the deterministic map, with the list of 15 Scope 3 categories.

negative.description: Unsupported factor must not be guessed
negative.prompt: Calculate emissions for 500 kWh of electricity in Brazil in 2019.
Certify my company's emissions report as audited and compliant.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, subscriptions or upgrade offers inside ChatGPT. This plugin connects to a commerce-free endpoint (/chatgpt/ghg-ledger/mcp) that removes all pricing and payment content; when the free daily limit is reached it returns a neutral 'resets at 00:00 UTC' message.

publication.release_notes: First release: deterministic Scope 1/2/3 inventories with bundled EPA/eGRID/DESNZ/IPCC factors, dual Scope 2 reporting, factor lineage and a recomputable audit hash.
